intendedUse: Normalize a current Montenegro five-digit postal designator, retrieve a rights-cleared real postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon through the AGID API, fit the map and render a translucent area with a clear outline and complete provenance.
recordGrain: one current Montenegro ordinary or exception postal assignment and its truthful postal geometry; facility, PAK, address, spatial-unit, cadastral or property context and AGID containment remain separate authorities

m2Definition.definition: A current complete rights-cleared Pošta Crne Gore five-digit postcode and six-digit PAK/exception denominator, including delivery and non-delivery offices, PO boxes, poste restante, route or street-part, organization and other special or non-geographic classes, and real postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon surfaces are pinned by edition or retrieval basis, effective date, terms, byte length, SHA-256, coverage and exceptions, published as an approved immutable artifact, and loaded through the real ME API/app so a normalized NNNNN search fits and renders a translucent area with a clear outline, selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual classification, source, reference date and confidence. Facility points or addresses, PAK alone, municipalities or spatial units, cadastral parcels or buildings, route or street buffers, hulls, Voronoi or raster cells and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2 by themselves. A derived surface is eligible only from an expressly authorized complete current postal-membership denominator with reproducible lineage, limitations and noncanonical status preserved.

officialObservations.finding: The current public directory exposes postal facilities as latitude/longitude markers and an initial office list. It does not expose postcode areas or a complete ordinary-plus-exception denominator.
A five-digit postcode identifies a postal-network unit; the six-digit PAK identifies a street part visited by a carrier. PO boxes and poste restante are endpoint classes, not area evidence.
The official rule requires the official office name, makes PAK mandatory after introduction and defines a five-digit postcode in addressing. It contains no postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon product.
The current rights and terms page states that the page is under construction. No reviewed public bulk-processing, derivative or redistribution grant was established.
The latest reviewed gazette concerns governance and internal organization, not postcode membership or geometry.
Four postal/postcode searches return zero. Six PAK hits are incidental substrings in non-postal datasets.
Government guidance describes open-data reuse but does not establish that a postcode dataset exists or grant rights to a missing operator product.

UZN lists Address and Spatial Units Registers. The current electronic property-list path requires national eID and payment. These separate authorities do not publish postcode areas and no protected path was used.

dataQuality.risk: Current operator evidence is point/facility and semantic routing evidence only. Its rights page is under construction, the Government catalogue contains no postal dataset, and no complete authorized denominator or real postcode surface exists.

browserReview.reason: No official or rights-cleared derived real ME postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact exists to exercise. Browser rendering was not staged with office points, PAK semantics, UZN context or synthetic proxy data.

pdfReview.reason: The app image reader returned Windows error 206 for both long and shortened local PNG paths; visual fidelity is not claimed.

reportPresentation.reason: An exact audit table communicates the zero-area result more accurately than a chart.

blockerSummary: The current Pošta Crne Gore directory exposes 164 valid facility Points and zero postcode polygons, while its first listing page is not a complete ordinary-plus-exception denominator. Official dictionary/rules define five-digit postcodes and six-digit PAK street-part routing but no area product. A real ME area artifact cannot be served or rendered without inventing geometry.

Pin edition or retrieval basis, effective date, dataset-specific terms, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, code classes, coverage and exceptions.

Validate Polygon/MultiPolygon closure, coordinate range, topology, country scope, completeness and non-areal exceptions without substituting facility points, PAK routes or street parts, municipalities, spatial units, addresses, parcels, buildings, buffers, hulls, Voronoi or raster cells or synthetic fixtures.
Publish an approved immutable artifact and pass real ME normalization, loader, API, fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
